en: Rashid - What on earth is that??
GS - So this is the Citadel of the Sky?
Gishne - It's more impressive than I imagined. The Citadel of the Sky is said to be the dwelling of the Twelve Gods, and it really does float in the air.
GS - But how do we get up there?

Gishne - By teleportation. Normally I could never move this many people on my own, but the sealed place gives off magic that aids teleportation, so a simple spell will be enough for a powerful teleport.
Rashid - Do the Twelve Gods really live up there?
Gishne - In any case, let's go in.
